title: cert-machine: verification layers for AI-scale mathematical search (certified audits, proof-grounded evals, verified reward channels)
description: A conjecture engine and verification lab: generate mathematical objects at scale, screen in float, certify the survivors exactly (interval enclosures and exact rational decisions — a refutation here is proved), and hunt closed forms for what survives. The repository carries machine-derived, certificate-backed results with their full records: the value of lambda(4) (Chowla's cosine problem, finite front; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22225861), a certified hot-spots domain beyond every analytically proven class (the second Neumann eigenfunction of a convex trapezoid with no symmetry axis attains its extrema on the boundary only), certified mean-field-game equilibria with more density peaks than potential wells and the exact crossover 1/(8 pi^2), certified audits of AI-produced mathematics, and proof-grounded model evals. Every page recomputes its numbers from the certificates at build; planted red controls must fire; a build that drifts refuses to ship. Machine-derived with Claude (Anthropic) driving certified-arithmetic instruments; not peer-reviewed. Pinned third-party corpora under corpus/sources/ retain their own licenses.
